cluster_policy.env_creation_location: envs/ on shared filesystem before compute allocation

openpi_pi0.checkpoint_requirement: official OpenPI checkpoint such as pi0_base/pi05_base/pi0_droid/pi05_droid, or a documented faithful access/incompatibility blocker
openpi_pi0.dataset_requirement: Phase07 LeRobot dataset converted from stage-1 index without held-out leakage
openpi_pi0.comparison_requirement: official OpenPI policy adapter/inference or fine-tune followed by Newton Phase07 held-out closed-loop evaluation with metrics and full videos

gr00t.checkpoint_requirement: official Isaac GR00T checkpoint/weights or a documented faithful access/incompatibility blocker
gr00t.dataset_requirement: GR00T-flavored LeRobot v2 dataset with meta/modality.json from Phase07 stage-1 index
gr00t.comparison_requirement: official GR00T policy/fine-tune path followed by Newton Phase07 held-out closed-loop evaluation with metrics and full videos

diffusion_policy.checkpoint_requirement: official Diffusion Policy checkpoint when applicable, or faithful training/comparison using official code and a documented checkpoint limitation
diffusion_policy.dataset_requirement: official Dataset/shape_meta/replay-buffer path from Phase07 stage-1 index without held-out leakage
diffusion_policy.comparison_requirement: official Diffusion Policy Dataset plus EnvRunner that runs Newton Phase07 held-out closed-loop evaluation with metrics and full videos

rtx.checkpoint_requirement: official RT-1-X checkpoint such as the Open X-Embodiment RT-1-X release, or a documented faithful access/incompatibility blocker
rtx.dataset_requirement: RGB workspace frame plus task string plus 7D action mapping from Phase07 stage-1 index
rtx.comparison_requirement: official RT-X inference/fine-tune path or documented incompatibility, followed by Newton Phase07 held-out closed-loop evaluation where executable

required_order: Run Phase07 action-bridge backfill inside allocation.
Run Phase07 mainstream stage-1 dataset index inside allocation.
Prepare method environments locally under envs/ on shared filesystem.
Obtain official checkpoints or write faithful blocker reports.
Materialize official method datasets without held-out leakage.
Run closed-loop Phase07 held-out evaluations with metrics and full videos.
Only then compare curiosity against official methods.
